company.name: Data Mechanics
company.shortDescription: Data Mechanics is a serverless platform for data engineering and data science.
company.description: Data Mechanics is a managed Spark platform for data scientists and engineers. The platform tunes the infrastructure parameters (e.g. CPU, Memory) and Spark configurations (e.g. parallelism, shuffle, I/O) automatically and continuously for every pipelines to make them stable and performant, and provide an easy-to-use serverless experience to its users.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native platform that runs Apache Spark on Kubernetes clusters within a user's cloud account, managing Spark applications with automated scaling and configuration tuning.
productsAndServices.name: Ocean for Apache Spark

productsAndServices.description: A hosted Spark UI alternative that collects and visualizes Spark application metrics via an open-source agent integrated into Spark workloads.
productsAndServices.name: Delight Spark UI
